briefdescription.para: A thin wrapper around BSD sockets.

detaileddescription.para: Sets the diagnostics area with a nicely formatted message for most errors (some intermittent errors such as EWOULDBLOCK, EINTR, EINPROGRESS, EAGAIN are an exception to this). The API is following suite of BSD socket API: most functinos -1 on error, 0 or a valid file descriptor on success. Exceptions to this rule, once again, are marked explicitly.
